above_fold.h1: Write Better Technical Docs — In Half the Time
above_fold.subheadline: Draftly is the AI writing assistant trained on developer docs, not blog posts. It understands APIs, code examples, and technical accuracy — and it shows.
above_fold.hero_visual_brief: Split screen: left shows a developer staring at a blank doc, right shows Draftly auto-completing a well-structured API reference with code examples. Subtle green checkmarks next to code snippets.
above_fold.primary_cta: Start Writing Free — No Card Needed
above_fold.social_proof_snippet: Trusted by technical writers at Stripe, Vercel, and Figma

problem_section.headline: Technical writing is painful. It shouldn't be.
pain_points: You spend 4 hours on a tutorial that readers skim in 4 minutes
Generic AI tools suggest code examples that don't actually work
Your docs backlog grows faster than you can write
Every API update means manually hunting down every affected doc
You're the only one who writes docs — and the team keeps adding features
problem_section.bridge: What if you had an AI that actually understood what you were writing — and got it right?

features_benefits.benefit_headline: It knows what your code does — not just what you typed
features_benefits.elaboration: Paste a code snippet and Draftly explains it accurately. Not a generic paraphrase — a technically correct explanation a developer would write. First AI writing tool our team hasn't had to fact-check.

features_benefits.benefit_headline: Start with the right structure, every time
features_benefits.elaboration: Quickstart guides, API references, tutorials, changelogs — each has a proven structure that readers expect. Draftly enforces it so you spend time on content, not formatting debates.

features_benefits.benefit_headline: Update your docs when your API updates — automatically
features_benefits.elaboration: Connect your GitHub repo. When a function signature changes, Draftly flags every doc that references it and suggests the updated copy. The doc backlog that never ends — finally manageable.

testimonials.quote: I was skeptical because every 'AI writer' I'd tried was useless for technical content — it would just confidently hallucinate wrong API responses. Draftly is the first one that I don't have to babysit. I gave it our OpenAPI spec and asked it to draft an authentication guide. The draft was 80% publishable on the first pass. That's never happened before with any tool.
testimonials.result: Reduced first-draft time from 4 hours to 45 minutes

faq.a: Less than any other tool we've tested. We trained specifically on technical documentation — not fiction, marketing copy, or general text. We also flag when we're uncertain about a code example, rather than guessing. You're still the expert; we're the assistant.

faq.q: How is this different from GitHub Copilot?
faq.a: Copilot writes code. Draftly writes the documentation, tutorials, and reference material that explains the code. They're complementary — many of our users use both.

faq.q: We have a custom doc style guide. Can Draftly follow it?
faq.a: Yes. Upload your style guide in Settings and Draftly references it for every suggestion. Our Teams plan includes style guide sync across your entire team.

final_cta.headline: Your docs backlog isn't going to write itself.
bullets: Onboarding call with a technical writer on our team
final_cta.risk_reversal: No credit card. No automatic charges. If you don't love it, email us and we'll help you export everything you wrote.
